notes: The supplied file contains 8 paper copies but only 6 distinct papers: 'Supplementary Semester Examination – January 2023' and 'Regular & Supplementary Summer 2024' each appear twice. Duplicate copies were counted once.
The papers state Semester IV and Computer/Computer Science Engineering; the project brief says Semester 5. Subject codes differ by paper (BTCOC402, BTCOC403, BTCOC403_Y19).
Regular & Supplementary Summer 2024 prints the date 14/06/2023, inconsistent with its 2024 title; the title year (2024) was used.

Jan 2023: the single number after each part looks like a Level/CO value, not marks, so marks are null for those questions; only the 12-mark question totals are printed. In Winter 2023 the number in parentheses is likewise recorded in level_co, with 6 marks per part as printed.
Objective (MCQ) questions are extracted individually (12 in W24, 12 in S25) with their options in the options field; no question was solved and no answers are included.

Repetition groups require the same core ask. Groups with wording variants carry a repetition_note. Numerical questions that share a reference string or table but differ in frames, algorithms or values were NOT grouped; see numerical_analysis.observations.
Short notes with two items (SU24 Q4B, S25 Q5A, J23 Q1B) are split into one record per item; multi-part numericals (several algorithms or sub-asks) stay one record.
Topic priority rule used in topic_frequency: high = 4+ appearances, medium = 2-3, low = 1. Question priority follows the brief (3+ high, 2 medium, 1 low).
Question years in years_asked are distinct years; papers_asked lists each appearance by paper. Several papers share a year (2023: three papers; 2024: two).
Scrambled watermark text in the source file was ignored.
Unit assignment for the storage-hierarchy question and the maskable-interrupt objective question is a best fit (Unit 1) and flagged verification_needed.
